Kopi Hutan Arabica Beans 500g

RM 89.00 RM 72.00
4.8 out of 5 (126 reviews)

Grown by smallholder farmers on the slopes of Gunung Kinabalu at 1,200 to 1,500 metres, our Kopi Hutan lot is hand-picked and washed before drying on raised beds. We roast it to a medium profile that keeps the bright acidity and brings out notes of brown sugar, red apple and cacao nibs.

Every bag is roasted to order in Shah Alam and shipped within 48 hours of roasting, so the beans arrive at their best. For espresso we recommend resting the beans for 7 days after the roast date printed on the bag.

  • Origin: Kundasang, Sabah
  • Process: Washed
  • Roast level: Medium
  • Tasting notes: brown sugar, red apple, cacao nibs

Specifications

Net weight500 g
Altitude1,200 – 1,500 m

Shipping and returns

Orders placed before 2pm on a working day are roasted and shipped the next working day. Delivery takes 2 to 4 working days in West Malaysia and 4 to 7 working days to Sabah and Sarawak. Unopened bags can be returned within 14 days for a full refund.
